digest.component_or_area: transition close command and signing tail
propositions: rebar transition command returns exit 0 with machine-undetectable completion signature failure when the close lands but the signature append times out on write_lock after ~60 seconds

SigningError in the signing tail (line 434) is caught and dropped to stderr with no field in the return payload, so callers cannot distinguish successful close-without-signature from transient signing failure

completion_signature payload field with {signed: bool, cause: str, error: str} structure must be threaded through library, CLI JSON, and MCP surfaces to make signature outcome machine-readable at call sites
closed-vocabulary cause values (signed / sign_failed / material_drifted / force_bypassed) must be absent from idea→closed transitions and non-close transitions, since those have no completion intent
stderr message must state the close LANDED and only the signature failed, not present the lock error as a failed close
exit code must remain 0 per frozen contract; new codes are release-window decisions, and reusing 1 would harm agents that retry on failure
